decisions.reason: The supplied publication date, October 11, is within the run's preceding 30-day window as of October 13, 2026; the October 14 retrieval date does not establish novelty. This is a generic product/news roundup, not inspectable evidence about experimental automation. Its potentially relevant Epoch and ATLAS entries provide descriptions and outbound links, without the original studies' methods, budgets or results; those claims cannot be evaluated from this item. See the saved [AI resources passage](data/assets/78deb02bb43b9240c74487b3/4c16684f04ac89de0cfd2e9942cde9c20a91e0d7aa7d934da6ede6eaa2463817/text.txt#:~:text=AI%20resources). Reject the roundup rather than treating linked research as supplied supporting evidence or independent corroboration. The publisher promotes paid material in [“All my paid goodies in one place”](data/assets/78deb02bb43b9240c74487b3/4c16684f04ac89de0cfd2e9942cde9c20a91e0d7aa7d934da6ede6eaa2463817/text.txt#:~:text=All%20my%20paid%20goodies%20in%20one%20place); additional commercial relationships are not established by the supplied evidence.

The supplied September 30 publication date falls within the run's 30-day window. Useful new evidence is the controlled comparison of minimal and elaborate research-agent harnesses, not the older benchmark literature. The authors report matched backbones, worker hardware and budgets, withheld MLE-bench test feedback, and component ablations ([Sections 3–4](data/assets/7f0901064878a294934bd154/6c598d9a3db4f487a0045a147e48bc3e4064e2b81bf388f4ac0947b9d96c78ec/text.txt#:~:text=3%20Experimental%20settings)). Their GLM comparison reports 62.5% self-selected medals for Malena versus 47.1% for AiScientist. However, the detailed tables qualify the broad 'matches or beats' language: Gemma significantly favors MLEvolve on percentile, and several other comparisons are inconclusive; absence of significance is not proof of equivalence ([D.2](data/assets/7f0901064878a294934bd154/6c598d9a3db4f487a0045a147e48bc3e4064e2b81bf388f4ac0947b9d96c78ec/text.txt#:~:text=D.2%20Detailed%20MLE-bench%20results)). Preserve the distinction between original default29 ablations and corrected fixed30 comparisons ([A.1–A.2](data/assets/7f0901064878a294934bd154/6c598d9a3db4f487a0045a147e48bc3e4064e2b81bf388f4ac0947b9d96c78ec/text.txt#:~:text=A.1%20MLE-bench%20tasks%20used)). NatureBench adds a second benchmark, not independent replication: unlimited evaluation queries and oracle selection create unequal scoring opportunities ([D.6](data/assets/7f0901064878a294934bd154/6c598d9a3db4f487a0045a147e48bc3e4064e2b81bf388f4ac0947b9d96c78ec/text.txt#:~:text=D.6%20NatureBench)). Costs are modeled, including an assumed cache discount; separate multi-GPU backbone serving from the single-A100 experiment worker ([A.4](data/assets/7f0901064878a294934bd154/6c598d9a3db4f487a0045a147e48bc3e4064e2b81bf388f4ac0947b9d96c78ec/text.txt#:~:text=A.4%20LLM%20backbones%20used)). This is an author-run preprint comparison: the authors acknowledge ownership of Malena, possible tuning asymmetry, contamination risk and only 3–4 seeds for 24-hour runs; independent replication and outside practitioner assessment are not supplied ([G.1](data/assets/7f0901064878a294934bd154/6c598d9a3db4f487a0045a147e48bc3e4064e2b81bf388f4ac0947b9d96c78ec/text.txt#:~:text=G.1%20Limitations)). Editorial inference: students should benchmark a simple agent first, protect evaluation data and measure selection quality and total cost. Accept for reporting and scrutiny, not as a universal demonstration that harnesses are useless.

The supplied October 1 publication date is within the run's 30-day window, but the contribution is a tutoring prompt and flashcard workflow, not evidence about autonomous computational experiments. The author's puppy-training demonstration produces 37 cards without a controlled baseline, independently checked knowledge assessment or measured learning outcome ([demonstration](data/assets/810ca788d6580a6871563f4d/2ec6998b1c53899734b6cb244fefc18311d1635c79e90220c4b2743ae1235252/text.txt#:~:text=As%20a%20test)). Chatbot-generated diagnostic scores do not establish their accuracy. The recent workflow offers no qualifying experimental novelty for this series, despite its general student relevance. The author directly benefits from promoting a subscriber-only skill ([“Dig deeper”](data/assets/810ca788d6580a6871563f4d/2ec6998b1c53899734b6cb244fefc18311d1635c79e90220c4b2743ae1235252/text.txt#:~:text=Dig%20deeper)); its inaccessible paid implementation does not warrant deferral because the visible item's core subject is outside scope.

The supplied October 7 publication date is within the run's 30-day window. The new evidence is three segmentation search campaigns applying an existing protocol; the reference segmentation results are from 2024, not a new development. The authors describe an immutable evaluator, frozen architecture and split, keep/revert decisions, and 24 experiments per campaign with a one-hour training budget per trial—not one hour for the whole search ([Methods and experimental study](data/assets/a007976d7a6dcb8c99635a7e/22bcded05aecba83c6a4594604bdc843c3061c7ccdf19d4be43c9ea27beaec4f/text.txt#:~:text=2%20Method)). This is directly useful for small, inspectable student experiments. Scrutiny must retain the conflicting modification outcomes: Dice helps the GX10 campaigns but hurts the 4070 baseline; model, hardware and configuration are confounded, so these observations do not isolate hardware causation ([3.1](data/assets/a007976d7a6dcb8c99635a7e/22bcded05aecba83c6a4594604bdc843c3061c7ccdf19d4be43c9ea27beaec4f/text.txt#:~:text=3.1%20Retained%20modifications)). Only Loop B receives a test evaluation; trials use one seed, small retained gains lack variance estimates, and the historical GAN comparison is compute-unmatched. The displayed 0.836 versus 0.833 test IoUs differ by 0.003, whereas the prose says 0.002; flag this unresolved numerical inconsistency rather than infer an unreported precision correction ([3.2 and Table 3](data/assets/a007976d7a6dcb8c99635a7e/22bcded05aecba83c6a4594604bdc843c3061c7ccdf19d4be43c9ea27beaec4f/text.txt#:~:text=3.2%20Comparison%20with%20the%20reference%20schedule)). A declared-space tuner comparison remains future work ([Conclusion](data/assets/a007976d7a6dcb8c99635a7e/22bcded05aecba83c6a4594604bdc843c3061c7ccdf19d4be43c9ea27beaec4f/text.txt#:~:text=4%20Conclusion)). The [abstract's repository link](data/assets/a007976d7a6dcb8c99635a7e/22bcded05aecba83c6a4594604bdc843c3061c7ccdf19d4be43c9ea27beaec4f/text.txt#:~:text=Research%20repository) supports a reproducibility lead, not verified reproducibility. This is the investigators' preprint account, with no independent replication, outside practitioner assessment or commercial-conflict disclosure supplied. Editorial inference: freeze evaluation, budget the entire search, repeat promising trials and test transfer before adopting retained edits as defaults.
